fact_text: A REIT is a pooled investment vehicle, run by a REIT management company, that holds real estate on behalf of its unitholders, similar in form to a mutual fund.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Conventional mutual funds in Pakistan may invest only in bonds and stocks, not property, which is why a separate REIT framework was needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Pakistan's REIT regulatory framework was introduced in 2008 and has since been revised by the securities regulator (SECP).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Four REIT types are permitted: development REITs, rental REITs, hybrid REITs that do both, and investment-based REITs that only invest in projects without operating them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: A REIT fund must be listed on the stock exchange, and the listing must be done within 3 years of the fund being created, so that the public can take part.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: A listed REIT gives unitholders liquidity, and small investors can accumulate units through regular periodic purchases.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

company: Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited
fact_text: The REIT management company was incorporated in 2008, and its first REIT fund, Dolmen City REIT, followed in 2015.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Dolmen City REIT was the first REIT fund in Pakistan and was listed on the stock exchange in June 2015.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The management said Dolmen City REIT was the first listed REIT in South Asia, ahead of India.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Management said Dolmen City REIT's total return, counting dividends and capital gains, exceeded 400% from its 2015 listing to the interview date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Management said Dolmen City REIT's annualised total return over the previous 10 years was above 22%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Management said Dolmen City REIT had about 11,000 unitholders as of the interview date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Management argued that listing under REIT rules gave Dolmen a corporate governance benefit, with professional management that improves management quality.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Globe Residency REIT was offered to investors at Rs10 per unit in December 2022.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Globe Residency REIT had paid dividends of about Rs8.5 per unit since its December 2022 offer, according to management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Management said the unit price of Globe Residency REIT had doubled from its Rs10 offer price by the interview date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: A World Bank study, as cited by the interviewee, puts Pakistan's housing shortage at about 10 million homes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Mortgage debt to GDP in Pakistan is said to be the lowest in the world, which the interviewee cited as a reason housing finance is weak.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Banks hold nearly 90% of Pakistan's financial assets, so bank participation is central to funding real estate investment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Banks put about 60 to 65% of their funds into government securities, leaving little to lend to real estate and to blue-chip clients.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Buying a livable real estate asset in Karachi needs at least about PKR 2 crore, which most people do not have, so pooled REIT units give small investors access.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: About 70% of global wealth is said to be held in real estate, which the interviewee cited to show its weight in economies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Real estate is capital intensive, and without formal finance, developers organise their businesses differently and practices often suffer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Arif Hasan, a town planner cited by the interviewee, says about 50% of Karachi's population lives in unregulated slums.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Four regulators matter for REITs: the SECP (framework and custodian), the State Bank (bank exposure limits), provinces (land transfer duties) and the FBR (income tax).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Since 2022, regulators acting together improved REIT taxation, bank participation and SECP rules, which led to new REIT funds being launched from 2022-23.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The interviewee said 99% of property transactions are reported at the FBR valuation rate, which the interviewee argued makes policy-makers work with unreliable data.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Withholding taxes under sections 236 and 236C apply to the buyer and seller on property transfers, raising the cost of transfers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Under Sindh's floating-rate concept, stamp duty is charged at the FBR rate divided by the transaction value, so a transaction at 10 times the FBR rate pays a 1% duty.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Sindh dropped its floating-rate stamp duty concept in 2024, and the interviewee said the sponsors were asking for it to be reintroduced.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Punjab's stamp duty on property transfers to REITs is 0.5%, which the interviewee said gave REITs some relief.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The interviewee argued that the provinces should align transfer duties and adopt the floating-rate concept, and that the FBR should also adopt it, to disclose real transaction values.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Clause 99A of the Second Schedule to the Income Tax Ordinance exempted capital gains on transfers of property to a REIT, from 2008 until the clause expired in 2023.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Before July 2024, a non-business holder of built property was exempt from capital gains tax after 4 years, and of plots after 6 years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The capital gains exemption did not apply to property held as business income, so developers formed separate companies to qualify.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The interviewee argued the expired capital gains exemption for property transferred to REITs should be renewed, since sponsors hesitate to transfer property that would be taxed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Since the 18th Amendment, land transfer duties and taxes are provincial, so REIT developers must deal with each province separately.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The interviewee called Pakistan's income tax regime excessive, saying it drains business liquidity and matters more than law and order for attracting business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: The interviewee said Pakistan's market offers valuation multiples of about 6 to 8, which he considered the most attractive in the world.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Rent from REIT property rises every year, which the interviewee said gives investors income growth and a hedge against inflation, and is Shariah compliant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Sponsors often keep property outside REITs because transferring it creates a book gain and tax, while the interviewee said they receive no cash on contribution.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

fact_text: Interest rates, exchange rates and inflation are volatile, and there is no hedging mechanism, so sponsors must find their own protection and commit long term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

company: Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited
fact_text: The management said a new REIT would list in one or two months after the interview, and the group has 15 more REIT funds created to be listed gradually.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing in Real Estate Just Got More Exciting With Dolmen's New REIT Project | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-20)

company: Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited

fact_text: The interviewee said the REIT pipeline has trillion-plus projects under development, with banks, insurers and major business houses taking part.
